messages:
deploy-bot: staging deploy started — env=staging, tag=redwood-platform@v2.8.1, commit=abc1234def, initiated_by=maya.release, pipeline=ci/staging-rollout-2026-03-20, change_window=09:00-11:00 UTC. Notes: includes DB migration 'user_rate_limits', model reranker update (quant-profile=v1.4). Rolling update strategy applied. Links: https://ci.example.com/build/7823

maya.release: ack. I'll coordinate smoke and release notes. tagging the migration checklist in case we need a rollback.

jamal.oncall: oncall here — watching SLOs and error rates. @raj.infra please monitor node pressure and autoscale behavior during the migration.

raj.infra: noted. Will ensure maxUnavailable=1 for core services. If notification-service starts failing we'll pin it to previous image. I have a quick patch ready to pin via k8s rollout undo.

lina.qa: running smoke now: `./scripts/smoke_staging.sh --focus=api,reranker` — will paste brief results when done.

alex.pm: thumbs up. Release notes are drafted in #release-notes, adding the migration caveat and rollback steps.

ci-bot: CI: all pre-deploy checks passed, canary health OK (2/2 for canary slice).

--- ~18 minutes later ---

deploy-bot: staging deploy completed — SUMMARY: status=SUCCESS (partial mitigation applied). Duration=18m. Details: core-api: green; core-inference: green; reranker: healthy. notification-service: 2/3 pods CrashLoopBackOff due to schema mismatch with new events table. Auto-action: notification-service pinned to redwood-platform@v2.8.0 and traffic shifted to stable replica. DB migration: applied; backfill completed for ~120 rows (small sample). Links: logs https://logs.example.com/build/7823 , runbook https://wiki.example.com/staging-rollout-2026-03-20

lina.qa: smoke results: API 200/200, p95 latency=120ms, reranker correctness checks passed. Noted notification failures in integration tests, reproduced locally against new schema.

maya.release: good catch. Opening follow-up ticket INC-452 for notification schema compatibility. Plan: small schema change rollback on notification consumer, then re-deploy notification-service and re-run migration dry-run in staging. Will not promote to dedicated until fix lands.

jamal.oncall: I'll keep oncall for the next hour and watch for error surge. Escalate if errors > 5% or p95 > 500ms.

raj.infra: I applied a k8s image pin annotation on notification-service deployment and added a rollback annotation to the deploy metadata. Also captured heap/CPU snapshots for the two failed pods.

deploy-bot: pinned image: notification-service -> redwood-platform@v2.8.0. All routing restored to stable. If anyone needs raw rollout events: https://ci.example.com/build/7823/events

alex.pm: thanks everyone — will update release notes and customer-facing changelog to mention staged migration and hold for notification patch.

maya.release: closing this thread for the primary rollout. Follow-ups: INC-452 (notification fix), TASK-879 (migration dry-run + verification). I'll schedule a quick re-deploy once those are green. :white_check_mark:
